sections.heading: Introduction
sections.text:
The Evil bone pile is a creature spawner found in Burial Chambers, Swamp and Mountain.
The pile can spawn melee and ranged skeletons:
• melee Skeleton (80% chance)
• ranged Skeleton (20% chance)
Spawned enemies have a 12.75% chance to be 1 star and a 2.25% chance to be 2 star.
The nest activates when there is a player within 20 meters. The nest attempts to spawn within 2.28 meters every 6 seconds until there are 2 Skeletons within 20 meters.

sections.heading: Notes
sections.text:
• In Burial Chambers they may not spawn anything if there are skeletons in nearby rooms.
• It is recommended to dispose of them as soon as possible because they will continuously spawn in hostile creatures.
• If kept alive, these can provide a useful and infinite source of resources that the hostile creatures may drop.
